Name: White Demetrius (Quixotic)
Author: quixoticcool
Description:
This just replaces Demetrius' portraits with color corrected versions of Clint's and recolors his sprite.

I'm hoping to do a full on reportrait once I have the time. I also want to work on removing all references to Robins previous marriage and make Sebastian and Maru full siblings but don't really know where to start with that so don't get your hopes up for that mod anytime soon. I recommend you use this alongside [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/15882179]STulio[/url]'s White Maru if you like the sound of one big happy Robin family. You may also like [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8579763]SurtrDraugr[/url]'s White Demetrius but personally i think his portrait looks a bit too much like a black guy in white-face.

KNOWN ISSUES
-Demetrius' new sprite color looks a little washed out compared to the other spites
